name: cro-kit
description: Conversion rate optimization (CRO) for your own pages, forms, checkouts and A/B tests. Says what to fix first on a landing, pricing or signup page, separating clear fixes from questions that need research, and judges real-user speed and goal tracking when you supply them. Reviews a form, signup or checkout field by field and checks the order step against EU and US checkout rules. Finds where a funnel loses people and whether a traffic-mix shift explains a drop. Sizes an A/B test in visitors per arm and weeks at your traffic. Reads a finished or running A/B test: figures that disagree, an uneven split, early stopping, the lift with its p-value as a number and an interval, then ship, hold or keep running. Works on page text and aggregate counts; it does not write marketing copy or build deceptive variants.
